class Solution { public static int trap(int[] elevationLevel, int finale) { int holes = 0,dada=0; for (int i = 1; i < finale - 1; i++){ int left = elevationLevel[i]; for (int j = 0; j < i; j++){ if(left<elevationLevel[j]) left=elevationLevel[j]; } int right = elevationLevel[i]; for (int j = i + 1; j < finale; j++){ if(right<elevationLevel[j]) right=elevationLevel[j]; } if(left<right) dada=left; else dada=right; holes += dada - elevationLevel[i]; } return holes; } public static void main(String[] args){ Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in); int[] elevationLevel ={0,1,0,2,1,0,1,3,2,1,2,1}; int finale = elevationLevel.length; int ret = new Solution().trap(elevationLevel, finale); System.out.print(ret); } }
